crossRefs.note: You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It…
the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;
My heart is toward the governors of Israel, who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless Yahweh!
But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: And the people blessed all the men who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
translations.asv: And the people blessed all the men that willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.
